en: Vintage sepia-toned street view titled "Graz – Annenstrasse." The image shows a broad urban avenue with tram tracks running down the center, lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings that have shuttered windows and ground‑floor shops. Pedestrians, a few carriages or early trams, and streetlamps are visible along the street. The perspective looks straight down Annenstrasse toward the city center.
